inspection_method: Folder listing; HTTP range reads of ZIP central directories (no member data downloaded); the CSV was downloaded to a temporary directory outside the repository, audited with aggregate-only output, then deleted.
redistribution_policy: No file below is approved for public redistribution. Nothing from this folder is committed to Git.

files.name: Anemia_Dataset.csv
files.indirect_identifiers: Sex; combined with small sample size this may aid re-identification
data_quality_notes: 22 rows labelled Anaemic=No have Hb below WHO sex-specific non-pregnant cut-offs; the labelling rule is unknown.
Colour percentages come from an undocumented ROI, device, and lighting pipeline.
files.provenance: Unknown. Column structure suggests a public conjunctiva-colour dataset, but the source was not confirmed.

files.name: archive.zip
files.structure: dataset anemia/{India (383 files), Italy (481 files)}/<patient number>/ with full-eye JPEG plus palpebral/forniceal segmentation PNGs; India.xlsx, Italy.xlsx, Dataset anemia.docx
files.target_labels: Hgb per patient in India.xlsx / Italy.xlsx (columns Number, Hgb, Gender, Age, Note per the Colab notebook output)
files.direct_identifiers: Facial-region eye photographs are biometric data; spreadsheets hold age and gender
files.provenance: Matches the Kaggle dataset path used by the Colab notebook (harshwardhanfartale/eyes-defy-anemia). Original publisher and terms not confirmed in this audit.
files.notebook_observation: The notebook found 110 of 398 matched palpebral PNGs unreadable.

files.name: CP-AnemiC (A Conjunctival Pallor) Dataset from Ghana.zip
files.structure: Single nested 'CP-AnemiC dataset.rar' (8,281,392 bytes uncompressed in the ZIP); contents not listed. Inspected locally 2026-10-22: 710 RGBA PNGs (Anemic/ 424, Non-anemic/ 286) + Anemia_Data_Collection_Sheet.xlsx
files.target_labels: HB_LEVEL g/dL per image (3.1-15.0); Severity/REMARK follow WHO 2011 child cut-offs
files.direct_identifiers: None by name; hospital, town, region, age (months), sex; conjunctiva images
files.provenance: Title indicates a published conjunctival-pallor dataset from Ghana; source and terms not confirmed.
data_quality_notes: 91 groups of byte-identical images (303 rows) are labelled as different children; excluded.

files.name: Neonatal Jaundice Assessment A Dataset of Forehead and Sternum Images for Bilirubin Estimation.zip
files.target_labels: None present: no CSV/XLSX/JSON/text member. Filenames are sequential numbers and carry no bilirubin value.
files.direct_identifiers: Infant skin photographs; treat as sensitive health images
files.provenance: Title indicates a published bilirubin-estimation dataset. Its labels may be distributed separately by the original publisher; they are not in this copy.

files.name: NJN.rar
files.structure: Inspected locally 2026-10-22: jaundice.zip (200 JPG), normal.zip (560 JPG), Pythons_Code_AI_Testing_Data.zip (train.csv of 761 colour-feature rows not linkable to files, one script)
files.target_labels: Binary folder class jaundice/normal only; no bilirubin values; labelling rule undocumented
files.direct_identifiers: Newborn photographs (sensitive health images); no patient IDs
